notes: Negative test cases are successful when the documented HTTP status and stable RFC 7807 code match. For example, blocking oneself passes only when the response is 400 with code SELF_BLOCK.
notification-service has no public REST endpoint. Its collection request verifies that no public notification endpoint is exposed; FCM delivery remains an Android/iOS end-to-end check.
No access token, refresh token, user profile data, media URL, or response payload is stored in this report.
